event_name: Gerber Collision & Glass Route 66 NHRA Nationals presented by PEAK

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 83 degrees, relative humidity 58 percent, barometer 29.82 inches, adjusted
altitude 3,102 feet, track temperature 105 degrees.

This is the first time Gordon and Brown have faced each other in eliminations.

Brown with a slight starting line advantage and never trailed for the win. Antron Brown's MOV: 0.0356 seconds
(approximately 17 feet).

Stewart is 3 - 1 against Hart in prior events. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage, but was up in smoke right at the hit and he clicked it off.

Hart is straight down the groove with a good clean pass.

This is the first time Smith and Pruett have faced each other in eliminations. 

Smith won his first Top Fuel round in round one.

Smith with the starting line advantage, but then has problems right at the hit.  The word is there is oil in
his lane.   Will Smith was charged with an oildown, #1 for the season.
That will cost 5 points.


Pruett was on a good pass early and then started to smoke the tire, but got the win.  She will give up lane
choice to Brown in the semifinal.

Langdon is 28 - 22 against Kalitta in prior events. 

Kalitta with the starting line advantage, but lost traction early and clicked it off.

Langdon launched hard and kept it hooked up for the win.  He will give up lane choice to Hart in the
semifinal.
